description: MainActivity.java: This is the main launcher activity for an Android application, containing logic for fragment management, menu handling, dialogs, notifications, and user interaction. It manages the UI behavior across different screen sizes and themes.

classes.name: MainActivity.MyDialogFragment
classes.description: A nested static class extending DialogFragment to show custom dialogs with message passed via arguments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores state, sets layout, and configures action bar and fragments.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the activity's options menu, removing camera option if feature unavailable.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu items' titles and visibility based on current activity state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections for camera, theme toggle, dialog, notifications, etc.

methods.name: toggleVisibleTitles
methods.description: Animates showing/hiding of the TitlesFragment with customized animations depending on orientation.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles intent with ACTION_DIALOG to display custom dialogs.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Creates and shows a DialogFragment with specified message.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification, optionally with custom content view.

methods.name: getDialogPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent that launches the activity with a message to show a dialog.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current theme ID and titles visibility state.
